title: tectaria prolifera
intro: Tectaria prolifera, commonly known as the Lizard Tail Fern, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its numerous health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and gastrointestinal disorders. The therapeutic actions of Tectaria prolifera include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its ability to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal effects.
